home.title: Toolii Online Toolkit
home.subtitle: ID photos, image processing, PDF tools, and text utilities -- all in one place.
home.seoDescription: Toolii offers online tools for ID photo processing, image compression, format conversion, PDF merging, text analysis, and more.
home.seoKeywords: online tools,ID photo,image compression,HEIC to JPG,PDF merge,word counter
home.idPhotoDesc: Background removal, compliance check, and print layout (watermark-free export after login).
home.imageToolsDesc: Compression, HEIC conversion, format conversion, mosaic, and scan enhancement.
home.pdfToolsDesc: Compress, merge, split/reorder, and images to PDF.
home.textToolsDesc: Word counter, character counter, and AI token counter.
home.fileTransferDesc: Upload files and share via short link. Free for logged-in users.
home.faceMapDesc: AI face aesthetics consultant with personalized scoring and style recommendations.
home.faceSimilarityDesc: Upload two faces, AI analyzes facial similarity! Free, no login needed.
